note: Name buckets for the house project standard. Kept as data so the extractor script stays ASCII-only (PowerShell 5.1 decodes BOM-less scripts as ANSI, so Chinese literals inside a .ps1 corrupt its syntax).

buckets.meaning: 工站/工序程序；一台设备的每一个工位或工序一段
设备/轴控制程序（气缸、真空、轴、通信、手自动）
功能块调用层；把全局设备映射接到可复用 FB

buckets.pattern: ^(IO输入|IO输出|高速计数器输入|模拟量输入|初始化|设备状态|Alarm|报警|HMI|版本管理|安全|配方)$
buckets.meaning: 平台功能：IO 映射、初始化、设备状态、报警、HMI、版本管理

motion.note: The motion subtree lives in the project's WsTreeEnv.xml; no snapshot route materializes it, so its absence in a snapshot is a route gap, not evidence that the project has no motion settings.
